core_meaning.short_meaning: Compeller, one who helps the broken
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gabir corresponds to the Arabic form جبر (Arabic root ج ب ر (j-b-r); جابر (Jābir)). Its core sense is compeller, one who helps the broken. Gabir most plausibly corresponds to Arabic جابر (Jābir) 'one who sets a broken bone, restores, helps; the compeller', from the root ج ب ر (j-b-r). The source gave جابر as the Arabic form but جیبر as the Urdu form (non-standard) and glossed it 'the one who is free from anger', which is a different root (ك ظ م). The identification with Jābir is probable.
